description.value:
Exotic mixed drug. Lasts 24 hours.

Primary: You become someone else: a new character with the same gear, chrome, EMP, BODY, REF, WILL and DEX; MOVE, COOL and LUCK and Skills can swap.

Secondary (DV12): You flip between selves when you sleep; remembering takes DV15 Concentration. Three straight weeks of Addiction Therapy cures it.

Recipe: Suitup, Evil Tina, DumDum, exotic chemical.
